name: direct buy single product
author: Aashish khambu

sections.description:
Direct Buy Single Product is a simple yet powerful plugin that lets you link or button-click a product for immediate purchase. Instead of adding to the cart and navigating multiple steps, this plugin sends users straight to the checkout page — saving time and increasing conversions.

More Info

Visit my portfolio and plugin page for more details and updates:
– aashishkhambu.com.np
– aashishkhambu.com.np/plugin/direct-buy-single-product/

🎯 Perfect For:

– Flash sales or limited-time offers
– Single-product WooCommerce stores
– Email campaigns with “Buy Now” CTAs
– Affiliate marketing and ad landing pages

🔧 Features:

– Redirects users to checkout for a specific product
– No complex setup — just install and activate
– take selected product to checkout without changing cart items
– Customizable button text and styles
– Cookie-based tracking for smarter behavior
– Premium support and priority updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/direct-buy-single-product directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use a link like https://yoursite.com/?direct-buy-product=123 to allow direct purchase of any product by its ID.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the button text or appearance?

Yes, this includes customization options.

Will it restore previous card product?

Yes, it will restore previous card item like it was never gone.

Does it take selected product directly to checkout page?

Yes, it take selected product directly to checkout page.
